evals.prompt: Review error handling in ProfileRepository.swift — it uses try? everywhere and catch {} in a few places.
evals.expected_output: Findings on swallowed errors with domain-error fixes.
expectations: Flags each try? and empty catch {} by line as hiding an error
Proposes a domain error enum for the repository layer instead of a raw Error
Rethrows or passes CancellationError through instead of turning it into a failure

evals.prompt: How should I show an error message to the user when the network call in this view model fails?
evals.expected_output: A mapping from domain error to a localized user-facing string.
expectations: Maps the error to a localized string from the error type, not a raw error description
Keeps cancellation out of the user-facing error path
